No, as a Leafy Plus member you don't pay the $6.95 fee for change-of-mind returns. A planter is a non-living item, so it's eligible if you return it within **30 days** of delivery, unused and in its original packaging.

Start the return from "My Orders" and a prepaid label will be emailed to you. The label expires after **7 days**, so drop the parcel off within that window. Your refund will be issued to your original payment method within **5 business days** of the return reaching our warehouse.
